scope summary: JT/T 1037-2022 directly covers highway-bridge structural monitoring system design, implementation, acceptance, operations/maintenance, monitoring content and point layout, methods, systems, data management and monitoring applications. GB 50982-2014 covers monitoring and warning for buildings and bridge structures; clause 3.1.8 requiring warning values is mandatory. A 2024 Ministry of Transport big-data application guide lawfully reveals operational use of JT/T 1037-2022 Table 9 multi-level exceedance thresholds.
overlap: Overlaps B1/B3/B4 on general SHM process, but adds bridge-specific prescriptive system lifecycle, point layout, data governance, applications and thresholding. GB 50982 is broader and partly overlaps JT/T 1037; JT/T 1037-2022 is the primary acquisition target. The downloaded 2018 article explains the superseded 2016 code, so it is orientation evidence rather than a substitute for the 2022 text.
recommendation: HIGHEST — buy JT/T 1037-2022 English translation first; use the official lawful GB 50982-2014 copy before deciding whether any paid translation is needed.
rationale: This is the closest foreign normative analogue to the requested bridge SHM architecture and spans system architecture, lifecycle governance, data and warning/application layers. Climate similarity is secondary; direct highway-bridge specificity and current operational guidance make it uniquely valuable. Confirm translation completeness and that annexes/tables are included before purchase.
